name: Rift Masters 2027
overview: Rift Masters 2027 is a Tier 1 international League of Legends event played after the Mid-Season Invitational and before the final Worlds run. Organized by Riot Games, it takes place in Chicago, Illinois, USA, from September 25 to October 3, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 750,000. Twelve teams qualify, two each from the LCK, LPL, LEC, LCS, LCP and CBLOL, with qualification emphasizing year-long performance and Global Circuit Points. Kairos has not qualified.
